name: Analytics Dashboard
goal: Build an analytics dashboard from governed source data.
desired_outcome: A permission-aware ingestion-to-visualization pipeline with freshness indicators.

clarifications.question: Which sources, refresh interval, and roles are approved?
clarifications.answer: Seeded CSV, daily refresh, owner and viewer roles.

risk: Visualizations cannot be trusted before source, freshness, and permission contracts are validated.
warning: Ingestion dependencies must precede dashboard work.
